visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with green-streaked hair, pearls on her face, and heavy pink eye makeup speaks directly to the camera in a medium close-up shot within an indoor room featuring framed artwork and a couch. (2) A hand holds up a single abalone shell in a tight close-up, followed by the woman gesturing with both hands near her face while animated Taiwanese dollar bills fly across the screen. (3) She mimics the action of a tailor measuring her waist with a tape measure, looking upward thoughtfully, while digital sparkles and colorful text bubbles surround her. (4) The woman clutches her abdomen with a pained expression, which then transitions to a static image of a beige shapewear bodysuit with a large circular cutout in the crotch area. (5) She holds a white triangular onigiri toy in front of her face, followed by rapid jump cuts showing her using her fingers to distort her lips into a similar triangular shape. (6) In a monochrome filter, she rests her chin on her hand as mathematical equations float around her head, indicating deep thought. (7) A close-up shows a hand placing the abalone on a vintage keyboard, followed by it being placed on a pink dumbbell and then resting on a miniature wooden beach chair. (8) Finally, she raises a fist with a determined look while showing the abalone shell once more to the camera against a bright background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic storytelling vlog where the creator recounts a humorous and slightly embarrassing experience with custom shapewear that was too tight. She uses exaggerated visual metaphors, such as comparing her body parts to an onigiri and 'training' an abalone, to engage the audience through self-deprecating humor and high-energy editing.
